incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT 1829991111 — autoscaler stalled in aws-eu-west2 (GPU quota / instance limit). Queue growth detected, service degradation risk. Paging #incidents and current on-call.

ana (oncall): ack — taking. pulling logs and checking autoscaler / cloud accounts.

corey: looking at autoscaler logs now, seeing a steady stream of `InstanceLimitExceeded` from AWS for `p4d`/`g4dn` family in eu-west-2. requests to create nodes are 429/403 / 500 from provider. queue length ~6.7k, token ingestion spiking.

marta: CS pinged — two enterprise customers reporting 5xx + timeouts: NimbusPay and DataRelic. Customer-impact flagged. I put them on a high-priority watch.

ana (oncall): quick triage notes:
- symptom: scale-up requests failing due to region GPU instance quota hardlimit (aws eu-west-2)
- impact: queued requests backlogged, latency >5s for some, some 503s for requests that hit short-circuit fallback
- initial mitigations: attempt fallback routing to other regions, drain non-critical batch pools, raise priority on quota request to AWS.

corey: commands/outputs:
```
# autoscaler status
kubectl -n inference get hpa,deploy,po | grep autoscaler
Autoscaler status: pending_creates=42, failed_creates=118, queued=6723
# cloud provider errors in logs
"error": "InstanceLimitExceeded", "message": "You have requested more GPUs than your current quota allows"
```

jason: I just opened AWS support case 9876543210 (severity: production-impacting). Asked for temporary quota bump for `p4d` and `g4dn` in eu-west-2 and for a faster review. Included our SLA and traffic graphs. Link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/home#/case/9876543210

lia: meanwhile we can reduce pressure — recommendation:
- scale down low-priority batch jobs in eu-west-2 (scale to 0)
- enable cross-region routing for non-sensitive workloads to us-west-2 (best-effort)
- increase evictable-cache TTL to reduce regeneration churn

lia: quick commands:
```
kubectl -n workloads scale deployment batch-worker --replicas=0 --selector=batch=low-prio
# toggle routing in infra console (API):
PATCH https://console.redwood.in/api/v1/routing/policy/eu-fallback
body: {"fallback_region":"us-west-2","percent":60}
```

ana (oncall): executing routing change now — switching 60% of EU non-sensitive traffic to us-west-2 fallback. Will monitor latency and error rate.

incident-bot: :information_source: Action logged: routing policy eu-fallback patched by ana. Notifying SRE lead.

corey: after routing change (5m): queue dropped 6723 -> 2100, error rate for affected endpoints dropped from 9.2% -> 2.1%. Metrics snapshot:
```
queue_depth: 6723 -> 2100 (8m)
5xx_rate: 9.2% -> 2.1%
p99_latency: 6.4s -> 2.2s
```

marta: CS update prepared and sent to NimbusPay/DataRelic. Short note: "We encountered a regional GPU capacity issue in eu-west-2; we applied cross-region fallback to reduce impact. We're working with the cloud provider to lift limits. No data exposure."

cs-rep: received confirmation from NimbusPay that bulk of their traffic is back to normal. They asked for ETA on permanent fix.

jason: AWS support acknowledged case and routed to capacity team; they requested exact instance types and timestamps — I uploaded needed logs and our projected consumption. Asked for temporary quota increase and long-term limit raise. ETA unknown.

lia: additional mitigation — evict low-value caches, enable KV prefix caching to reduce GPU token regen. I've applied cache TTL changes via infra feature flag.

ana (oncall): handoff / next steps:
- current state: mitigations applied (cross-region fallback + batch scale-down + cache tweaks), visible stabilization in metrics.
- outstanding: AWS quota increase pending; need follow-up with cloud account team for quota planning; runbook items: postmortem, capacity thresholds, improve autoscaler handling for provider quota errors.
- owners: janitorial tasks -> lia for cache and batch cleanup, corey for autoscaler telemetry and retry/backoff adjustments, jason for AWS escalation (follow up in 1h), marta/cs for customer comms.

ana (oncall): handing off to marta for overnight watch. marta, + please keep paging chain if queue > 3k or 5xx rate >3%.

marta: acked, taking overnight. I'll put a pinned note in #incidents and update the status page. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident 1829991111 — mitigations applied. Impact reduced. Incident tagged P1 -> monitoring. Created follow-up tasks: capacity-postmortem-1829991111, quota-escalation-followup-9876543210.

ana (oncall): quick postmortem stub: root cause = region GPU instance quota exhaustion + autoscaler lack of graceful fallback on provider rejections. Action items: 1) Improve autoscaler backoff + fallback to different instance families/regions automatically. 2) Pre-warm cross-region capacity and runbook for quota exhaustion. 3) Formalize priority throttling for enterprise vs free-tier traffic.

corey: adding a log hook to detect repeated InstanceLimitExceeded and trigger preemptive routing in future.

marta: will draft customer comms + postmortem for leadership review tomorrow.

ana (oncall): final note: if AWS doesn't approve quota within 6h we'll schedule a controlled traffic shed for non-critical customers to protect SLAs for enterprise pockets.

marta: okay. I'm closing the pager for now and will re-open if thresholds breach.
